verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a work-management platform, but the evidence never documents a bulk-edit or multi-item action capability. The pack only offers adjacent material: a general GraphQL API (a developer building block), board and item menu extension points, and an illustrative agent prompt ('Score our open deals…'). None of these is a documented bulk-operations feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
